_what: Chemistry constants behind the oxygen-demand table in docs/NITROGEN.md (section 3). Each is a textbook value, stated with where it comes from. Read live by scripts/nitrogen.py, so every derived ratio on the page is a calculation on these fields.

molar_mass_g_per_mol._source: IUPAC standard atomic weights (conventional values), rounded as used in scripts/nitrogen.py

redfield._source: Redfield, Ketchum & Richards (1963): remineralising one Redfield unit of algal organic matter (C106 N16 P1) consumes 138 mol O2

_bod_source: the conventional ratio of ultimate to five-day biochemical oxygen demand for domestic wastewater (BOD5 about 68% of ultimate); a typical value, not a Danish measurement
_sulphate_source: full-strength seawater at salinity 35; Danish waters are brackish and hold proportionally less
_oxygen_source: a round value for well-oxygenated temperate seawater, used as a scale, not a measurement
_si_source: Brzezinski (1985): diatoms take up silicon and nitrogen in roughly equal molar amounts
